files.name: Next Reminder 1.3.28 — Stable Files Rollback
files.notes: Stability rollback for the persistent Files freeze. Restores the entire File Sharing implementation to the verified pre-report stable source instead of carrying any Pending Report/PDF/background-send UI code in the Files view. Keeps the current app data, other app updates, Live Activity version alignment, and compiled AppIcon fix. Pending Report generation is temporarily removed from the app while Files stability is verified.

files.name: Next Multi Browser 1.1.9 — Main Random Environment Timer
files.notes: Adds Random Environment directly to the main browser screen with one menu for immediate randomization and automatic 1, 2, 3, 5, or 10 minute randomization. The timer selection is saved across relaunches and pauses while the app is backgrounded. Each run uses the existing global 20-profile environment randomizer, preserving cookies, Google logins, persistent website data, profile isolation, the iPad Pro 12.9 adaptive layout, URL queue, AutoFill, auto refresh, and VPN features.

files.name: Next Reminder 1.3.31 — Gmail Report Recovery Fix
files.notes: Fixes Pending Reports Send Email when Gmail tests successfully but the file-share request sees a stale connector. Send Report now uses the same secure Gmail recovery mechanism as the working email test path, synchronizes any refreshed connector ID, retries the PDF once, and shows the real HTTP/server error if retry still fails. Stable Files implementation remains unchanged.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.6 — Search & Swipe Delete
files.notes: Adds a native email search bar with case-insensitive filtering and a clear no-results state. Each account can now be deleted with a simple left swipe, including full-swipe deletion, and the updated list is saved immediately in Keychain. Existing account editing, one-tap copy, platform status buttons, automatic local generators, bulk import, Generate 5 More and the independent in-app browser remain unchanged.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.5 — Independent Browser
files.notes: Removes all hold gestures and signup actions from the platform cards, leaving one reliable tap to toggle and persist each green status. The separate Browser tab now opens Google by default and includes a manual address/search bar plus back, forward, home, stop and reload. The in-app WKWebView keeps normal website data without coupling browser navigation to accounts. Automatic local email/password suggestions, editor generators, Generate 5 More, bulk import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence remain included.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.4 — In-App Signup Browser
files.notes: Fixes platform-card taps so a normal tap reliably toggles and persists the green status. Press and hold now switches to a dedicated second Browser tab inside Next Accounts and loads the selected platform's signup page there instead of leaving the app. The in-app WKWebView keeps normal website data and provides back, forward, reload and signup controls. Automatic local email/password suggestions, editor generators, Generate 5 More, bulk import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence remain included.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.3 — Platform Signup Links
files.notes: Keeps the compact platform status workflow: tap Apple, Google, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter or TikTok to toggle its saved green state; press and hold to open that platform's official account-creation page in the system browser without changing status. Includes automatic local email/password suggestions, editor generators, Generate 5 More, bulk import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence. Suggested Gmail addresses are not registered accounts and availability is not guaranteed.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.2 — Automatic Emails
files.notes: Credential-free public build. Generates unique Gmail-style address suggestions and passwords locally for all 22 starting accounts. Upgrades preserve existing addresses and fill previously blank saved slots once. The account editor can generate a new email or password separately, and Generate 5 More creates five complete local entries. Platform status chips, bulk import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence remain included. Suggested addresses are not registered Gmail accounts and availability is not guaranteed.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.1 — Private Slots & Platform Status
files.notes: Credential-free public build. Creates 22 blank private slots and unique passwords locally on-device; upgrades keep only the first legacy account and replace the other 21 with blank slots. Adds compact per-account Apple, Google, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter and TikTok status chips, account editing, bulk email import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence.
